“Teammate orchestrated rendering across 48 sandboxes in parallel so that the whole process took only 3 hours”

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Jeff Grimes (@jeffgrimes9); megjelent: 2026-11-13T15:56:51+00:00; link: https://x.com/jeffgrimes9/status/2121271080254128633; média: videó, 118 másodperc]
Perplexity recreated the Pantheon in photorealistic detail.

I created a Video Production teammate that pulled survey dimensions and recent photos, wrote a three.js renderer including procedural shaders, and rendered the final video at 60 fps with motion blur on every frame.

Each frame took 80 seconds to render, and the teammate orchestrated rendering across 48 sandboxes in parallel so that the whole process took only 3 hours.

prioritas.indok: Egy Perplexity alapú demonstrációs projekt megosztása a cégvezető által. Forrás-tapasztalat: -4. A forrás P3-as híreiből eddig kb. 20%-ot fogadtál el.
